recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, mid-century modern album cover featuring a tight cluster of vibrant red roses with visible water droplets, set against a muted, textured cream background. The typography is bold, condensed, and layered directly over the floral imagery using a primary color palette of red and green.
coreVisualRelationships: Red roses dominate the central and lower frame, creating a dense organic mass.
Green typography overlaps the red petals, creating a high-contrast vibrating edge.
The cream background provides a neutral stage for the highly saturated floral subjects.
Small metadata text in the upper right balances the large display type on the left.
coreInvariants: Heavy halftone grain and paper texture throughout.
Vibrant, slightly warm red tones in the floral subjects.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A cluster of five to six large roses fills the bottom two-thirds of the frame, scaled to appear life-sized or slightly larger.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central, most forward-facing red rose acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the bold green text in the upper left, moves across the red title, and then descends into the detailed texture of the roses.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, restricted to the upper third and small gaps between leaves.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the subjects against a low-saturation, mid-value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same typeface family used in different colors, cases, and scales for contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature of the secondary text.
Matches the tall, narrow proportions of the primary title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a vintage 1960s-style photograph of a cluster of deep red roses with water droplets on a cream-colored textured paper background. Apply a visible halftone print texture and slight aging effects.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add extra-condensed bold sans-serif text. The top line should be red all-caps. The second line should be larger, green lowercase, and positioned to overlap the top edges of the roses.

verificationChecks: Is the green text overlapping the red roses?
Is the halftone texture visible across the entire image?
Are the roses a deep, saturated primary red?
Is the background a muted, off-white cream color?

adjustableVariables: Amount of water droplets on petals

mustAchieve: High color saturation in the florals

postGenerationChecks: Check for 'vibrating' color contrast between green text and red petals.
Ensure the halftone pattern doesn't obscure the petal details.
Confirm the background has a tactile, paper-like quality.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine high-saturation macro floral photography with bold, condensed mid-century sans-serif typography, unified by a heavy halftone print texture and a primary color palette.
